files.p.yaml:
cpl: "1.0"
id: vector-policy
version: 1
default: deny
rules:
  - id: allow-read
    match: {kind: [retrieval]}
    outcome: allow
files.q.yaml:
cpl: "1.0"
id: vector-policy
version: 1
default: deny
rules:
  - id: allow-big
    match: {kind: [tool_call]}
    when: {expr: "arguments.n > 3"}
    outcome: allow
